dog.description_text: Meet Shiloh — New Arrival! Shiloh just arrived and is still getting settled in, so we’re just beginning to learn who they are. Right now, everything is new—new people, new sounds, new routines—and we’re giving them time to relax, decompress, and show us their true personality at their own pace. Here’s what we know so far about her time in foster care: https://bestfriends.sharepoint.com/:b:/r/sites/GRP_NYC_Foster/Shared%20Documents/Forms/AllItems.aspx?id=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral%2FShiloh%20%2D%20About%20Me%2Epdf&parent=%2Fsites%2FGRP%5FNYC%5FFoster%2FShared%20Documents%2FGeneral&p=true&share=cQo5VGYWPokVR54HLtka8iBVEgUDuutPMd%2DBxwE6cyj69RTsfA Her foster says "When we first got her, Shiloh was incredibly excited to be out and about. Immediately upon walking into our apartment, she saw her crate and knew that was a designated space just for her. She absolutely loved people and the only time she would whine or make any noise was because she wanted cuddles. She had a cone for a little over a week because of recent surgery to get spayed, and after the cone removal she's been just as sweet, cuddly, and relaxed as before. She absolutely loves her crate and spends most of her day there, unless she's out requesting cuddles from my fiancée and I. She's the absolute sweetest dog! She's incredibly sweet, loyal, and calm." She is housetrained and has nice manners. She is spayed, vaccinated, microchipped , and has had preventative treatments to ensure she is ready for her next steps. Submit an adoption survey from above and our team will reach out via phone or email (check spam) to schedule a counseling call. Please remember, pets cannot be held or reserved.
